summary: Four new roles reach the shortlist, all permanent and all on employer-board APIs: n8n's Staff Platform Engineer for Agentic Engineering (developer productivity and AI coding agents, EUR 159-175k Western Europe tier) and its Engineering Manager (people management first), plus Cosuno's Senior Product Engineer (TypeScript, React, Node, EUR 90-120k, 100% remote from Berlin) and its AI Agents variant (needs 5+ years of Python). No freelance role is new, and nothing asking for Italian is open. The profile's only change was German at native level, which altered none of the eight roles carried over from the last sweep; of the 10-28 cohort, GiveDirectly and both LiveKit ads went stale (the October HN re-advertisements are over 30 days old) and Checkmk's team lead and Naxcon's ad are gone. Review: 2 demoted to kept (n8n Engineering Manager needs 1+ year of first-line people management; Cosuno AI Agents needs 5+ years of Python), AraCom's stated EUR 50-80k pay added, eventfirst remote score lowered to 1 and its pay range widened, Haufe senior pay confidence lowered; the shortlist is now 10 roles, not 12 (the opening sentence above predates the review), and every link was re-checked.
open_questions: Is an Engineering Manager role (n8n's, first-line people management with hiring and 1:1s) wanted under the tech-lead lane, or should roles that are mainly people management be dropped as off-lane?
